text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both in green territory, with Ethereum outpacing Bitcoin's daily gain at 6.1% versus 3.9%, suggesting appetite for risk assets beyond the largest cap. The Fear & Greed index sits at 22 (extreme fear) and has deteriorated further over the past week, indicating investors remain deeply pessimistic despite the price recovery. Bitcoin's dominance at 56.3% with $74B in daily volume shows orderly trading rather than panic liquidations, suggesting this bounce may reflect selective accumulation rather than broad euphoria.
